question: Which of the following diseases is caused by the human itch mite?
solution:
The correct answer is **Scabies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​​A** human itch mite infestation **causes scabies, which **affects the skin** (Sarcoptes scabiei var. hominis). In order to live and lay eggs, the tiny scabies mite digs into the **top layer of skin. **
 
• **Permethrin is the drug** of choice for treating scabies. **Apply topical permethrin every 2-3 days **for 1-2 weeks to treat crusted scabies. 
 
• 25% Benzyl benzoate (with or without tea tree oil) Permethrin can be replaced with **benzyl benzoate as a topical agent.**
 
• The** only infectious diseases that can be spread **by mites are scrub typhus and rickettsialpox. Chiggers and scabies are the two most prevalent ectoparasitic dermatoses **brought on by mites.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Measles is a severe respiratory** viral disease. The three "C"s, a pathognomonic enanthema (Koplik spots), and a maculopapular rash precede a prodrome of fever (up to 105°F) and** malaise, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis.**
 
• **One or more blisters** on or near the lips,** genitalia, or rectum are the characteristic **appearance of herpes lesions. 
 
• The** most distinguishing feature of rubella,** a common viral infection, is its red rash. German measles and three-day measles are other names for it.
